title: Shared 5.5e Vocabulary
description: Definitions referenced across more than one character sub-schema: the ruleset stamp, ability names, weapon mastery properties, and the provenance block every snapshotted entity carries.

contentOrigin.description: Provenance class of the content this entity was snapshotted from. Drives takedown response, attribution assembly, and export filtering. Distinct from is_homebrew, which only records whether the content came from a first-party catalog. user_authored = created by the user in this app, original to them. srd = from an SRD release under CC-BY. licensed = shipped by the operator under agreement with the rights holder (reserved; unused at v1). imported_unknown = entered or bulk-imported with unverified provenance (pasted from a file, typed out of a book, migrated from another tool).

is_homebrew.description: Retained for continuity and now derivable: true when content_origin is user_authored or imported_unknown. Pick one writer — computing it on write is safer than hand-setting both.

attribution_required.description: Whether displaying, exporting, or sharing this entity obligates reproducing a license notice. True for anything under CC-BY. Lets export assemble notices mechanically instead of by recall. Records THAT a notice is owed, not WHICH one; licensed content will need an attribution_notice_id before it can ship.
